caption_text: Since the 1980s, strange tiles have appeared embedded in asphalt on major streets in over two dozen cities across the Americas. Each one reads a variation of the same cryptic message about resurrecting the dead on a planet named Jupiter, referencing an old science fiction film. Installing them meant crouching in traffic at night, undetected, city after city, for decades. No one has ever been caught. No manifesto was ever found. Whoever did it simply stopped, and never explained why.
